states.name: neutre
states.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Production edit of the supplied Alicia paper mascot sprite.
Reference 1: the exact existing sprite to edit. Preserve its full-body neutral pose, complete silhouette, head proportions, twin ponytails, fringe, headband, black bow, pink cheeks, smile, coral dress, cream apron, stockings, shoes, all paper textures, shadows, canvas size and positions.
Reference 2: approved eye comparison board. Transfer ONLY the eye design from the MIDDLE column "2 · Yeux haricot". Do not transfer the other columns, composition or background.
Change ONLY the two eyes: shorter, plump rounded bean-shaped dark chocolate-brown cut-paper eyes with a slight concavity at the inner edge; one tiny matte cream cut-paper circular highlight near upper-left of each eye, about 15% of eye width. Same symmetrical eye size and eye-center positions as original. Subtle warm expression, simple eyes, no white sclera and no eyelashes. Preserve original eyebrows and mouth; preserve every other part of the character.
Paper material: flat matte layers with paper fibers; cream highlight is a tiny pasted paper dot with no glass gloss. Do not make eyes huge. Keep the approved friendly kawaii warmth.
Output ONE full-body character on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background with alpha, including the gaps between limbs and ponytails. No ground shadow, no background, no studio backdrop, no label, no text, no border, no watermark. All pixels outside the character should be transparent, with clean antialiased edges, no stray floating flecks. Preserve original canvas and foot registration.

states.name: ecoute
states.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit an existing transparent Alicia kawaii layered-cut-paper mascot sprite.
Reference 1 is the exact state sprite to edit: LOCK its entire pose, arm gestures, eyebrows, mouth, facial outline, body and head proportions, hair silhouette, blonde ponytails, fringe, black bow and headband, clothing, pink cheeks, complete paper texture, scale, canvas and planted shoes.
Reference 2 is the updated NEUTRAL Alicia with approved eyes: use it ONLY as the eye-design reference.
Change ONLY the two eyes in reference 1 to the same approved eyes from reference 2: plump short dark chocolate-brown bean/rounded oval paper shapes, a subtle inward curve, ONE tiny matte cream round paper dot near upper-left of each eye. Keep original eye-center positions and expressive eyebrow and mouth shapes from reference 1. No white sclera, no eyelashes, no glassy highlights, no large anime eyes. Preserve every other pixel region and keep exactly the same gesture as reference 1.
One full-body character, high quality matte cardstock layers and fine fibers. True transparent alpha background, including all gaps between limbs and hair. No cast ground shadow, no label, no border, no additional props, no text, no watermark, clean cutout edges without stray pixels. Preserve original framing and foot location.
STATE: ecoute. Keep the raised hand beside her ear, opposite arm relaxed, small closed smile, curious eyebrow.
